record_title: Exact Rényi-2 total correlation of Gaussian magnitudes and a spectral phase transition
provenance: SCOPE Phase II scientific record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Centered standardized Gaussian vectors and order-2 Rényi divergence only. The exact sign sum has exponential size; general Rényi orders, nonzero means, singular correlations, and non-Gaussian elliptical extensions are not resolved. Older multivariate Lancaster or folded-normal literature may contain an equivalent formulation; originality is to the best of our knowledge.
